text: Case ID: A system-generated unique identifier for the case. Text BCS-00059336
Open Date: The date this case was opened. Datetime 2025-08-22 14:09:46.271+00
Case Topic: The subject or service related to this case. Text
Service Name: The type of service that has to be rendered. Text Domestic Animal Issue
Assigned Department: The department this case was assigned to. Text Animal Care & Control
Assigned Team: The specific team within the department this case was assigned to. Text Animal control staff
Case Status: The current status of the case: "Closed" if the case has been closed "In progress" if the case is currently being worked on. Text Closed

Closure Reason: The reason this case was closed. Possible values: "Transitioned" if the case was reassigned to another agency "Noted" if no action is required "Resolved" if the case was resolved. Text Resolved
Closure Comments: Employee comments on findings or work done to close a given case. Text
Close Date: The date the case was marked as closed. Datetime 2025-08-22 14:09:46.271+00
Target Close Date: The target close date for this case Datetime 2025-08-22
On Time?: Whether the case was closed within the SLA. "ONTIME" if the case was closed on or before the Target Close Date, "OVERDUE" otherwise. Text ONTIME
Report Source: The medium through which this case was reported. Text Call
Submitted Photo: A link to the photo uploaded by the case reporter, if available. Text
Closed Photo: A link to the photo uploaded by the employee when closing the case, if available. Text
Full Street Address: The complete street address of the location the case was reported. Text 1 City Hall Plz, Boston, MA 02114

UNIT_NUM: Specific unit number within a housing complex
NUM_BLDGS: Total number of buildings of parcel

CASE_TITLE - Title given to a case. Most titles are self-evident. This field is entered by call
SUBJECT - Part of a case classification hierarchy (SUBJECT > REASON > TYPE) Subhect
denotes which department a case is assigned to:
REASON - Part of a case classification hierarchy (SUBJECT > REASON > TYPE). This is an
overall ‘umbrella’ for a collection of similar case types.
- Participatory Budgeting Idea Collection
TYPE - Part of a case classification hierarchy (SUBJECT > REASON > TYPE). Individual
- Ground Maintenance: Little Scobie Playground
QUEUE - Queue a case is assigned to. There are multiple queues within many departments
- BTDT_Engineering_New Sign and Pavement Marking
- PWDx_Missed Trash\Recycling\Yard Waste\Bulk Item
Department - Department a case is assigned to. This value is derived from the first 4 digits of
the queue column. For departmental information or descriptions see cityofboston.gov
- INFO - Information Channel (Not a department)
- No Q - No queue assigned (Not a department)
- HS_O - Housing - Office of Civil Rights
fire_district - BFD fire district case is within. There are 2 divisions and 9 districts. Division 1 is
comprised of Districts 1, 3 (includes old district 2), 4, 6, and 11. Division 2 is comprised of
- 3 - Beacon Hill, West End, North End, Charlestown
- 8 - Dorchester, Boston Harbor (Moon Island, Long Island)
- 12 - Roslindale, Hyde Park, West Roxbury
pwd_district - Public Works district tied to a case.
- District 1 - Boston Proper and Charlestown
city_council_district - City Council district a case falls within:
- District 1 - Charlestown, East Boston, North End (Sal LaMattina)
- District 2 - Downtown, South Boston, South End (Bill Linehan)
- District 5 - Hyde Park, Roslindale (Timothy McCarthy)
- District 6 - Jamaica Plain, West Roxbury (Matt O’Malley)
- District 8 - Back Bay, Beacon Hill, Fenway / Kenmore, Mission Hill, West End
- District 9 - Allston / Brighton (Mark Ciommo)
police_district - Police district a case falls within
neighborhood - Neighborhood relayed by caller and entered by call taker. There are
redundancies and missing values within this field.
- Fenway / Kenmore / Audubon Circle / Longwood
